stationScope.evidence: Stark Energy states on its current Germany charging page that its current ad-hoc charging price is 0.49 EUR/kWh incl. VAT, valid for credit-card or QR-code payment, and describes itself as operator of public fast-charging infrastructure in Germany. Current station-level chargecloud-backed observations independently show DE*ARK EVSEs at 0.49 EUR/kWh, including DE*ARK*E10014*001/*002 and DE*ARK*E10015*001/*002 at Rheinböllen and DE*ARK*E10045*001/*002 plus DE*ARK*E10046*001/*002 at Marburg. No roaming tariff is propagated.

roamingDeferred.reason: RFID/app partner pricing can differ from Stark Energy's own ad-hoc tariff and remains eMSP-specific.

note: Current direct ad-hoc tariff only. Older third-party snapshots showing 0.55 or 0.93 EUR/kWh are not used because the operator's current official page and live chargecloud-backed station data agree on 0.49 EUR/kWh. No blocking fee is added because Stark Energy's current public tariff page does not publish a universal time/parking surcharge.
